_readme: This file is data-only — CreditsScreen never needs code changes when you edit this.
Any key starting with '_' (like this one) is ignored by the loader — it's a comment.
Real JSON has no comment syntax, so use '_comment' / '_readme' keys instead.
TOP-LEVEL SHAPE:
timing: default fade_in / hold / fade_out (seconds) for every slide.
Override per-slide by adding 'fade_in'/'hold'/'fade_out' inside that slide.
slides: an array of slides, shown in order. Each slide is EITHER:
- a plain array of lines (uses the default timing above), or
- an object { 'lines': [...], 'hold': 3.5, ... } to override timing.
LINE TYPES (each entry in a slide's line list):
"Some Text"        -> name style: mixed-case font, e.g. person names.
{ "name": "..." }  -> same as above, explicit form.
{ "role": "..." }  -> role/job-title style, e.g. 'LEAD DESIGN'.
{ "title": "..." } -> big single-style heading, e.g. 'THANKS FOR PLAYING'.
""                 -> blank spacer line (adds vertical gap, renders nothing).
MULTIPLE LINES UNDER ONE ROLE:
Just list several name lines in a row after a { 'role': ... } line — see the
TIMED CREDITS slide below for an example with two names under one role.
LINE BREAKS WITHIN ONE ENTRY:
Put '\n' inside any string/role/title/name value to force a line break
without adding a separate array entry, e.g. "Line one\nLine two".
COMMAS:
Every comma (in name, role, or title lines) is automatically nudged down a
few pixels to sit on the baseline properly — nothing to configure here.
